text: The Guru language, or Boguru, is a poorly documented South Sudanese Bantu language of uncertain affiliation (though listed as unclassified Zone D.30 by Guthrie).

text: Boguru is an endangered indigenous language of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It belongs to the Niger-Congo language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by the elderly only.
